title: Instability of the ray-monotone selector for $W_1$-optimal transport
summary: For the distance cost $c(x,y)=|x-y|$, the set $O(μ,ν)$ of $W_1$-optimal plans is generally not a singleton. Under the classical absolute-continuity hypotheses in the Euclidean case, secondary variational selection by the quadratic energy $C_2$ yields the ray-monotone $W_1$-optimal plan. We provide a counterexample to an open problem posed by Santambrogio that concerns the stability of this selector under weak convergence of the marginals.
